newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche's Breuer - DAX rise not a one-way street.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche's Breuer - DAX rise not a one-way street.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG chairman Rolf Breuer on Wednesday said that investors had to be wary of a possible reversal in the German stock market, which has been pursuing a relentless rally in recent months.
"As it gets higher, one must keep in mind that this is not a one-way street," Breuer told the bank's interim news conference.
Breuer also said that he considered a dollar level of around 1.80 or 1.81 marks to be "sensible".
"At the current level I don't see any reason for the Bundesbank to act," Breuer said, responding to suggestions the Bundesbank would have to raise German interest rates to support the mark.
"I agree with (Bundesbank President Hans) Tietmeyer that what we have now is a correction of an overvaluation of the deutschemark," Breuer said.
